I hear you — that's a frustrating way for an event to go, especially with guests dealing with parking hassle on top of it. I'm not in a position to make any decisions about compensation or liability myself, so let me get our events manager to look into this and follow up with you today.

Could you share the event date and the name it was booked under so they have what they need to dig into it?
